pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT — pagerduty P3 fired: increased 429s on /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1). Trigger: request_rate > 1200/min for 3m. pd:PD-9832
oncall-bot: auto-ack by rotation (sam). escalation path: oncall -> eng-oncall -> eng-sre.
sam: I'm on it, grabbing logs now. pinging prod dashboards. ETA 10m. :coffee:
emma: thx, sam. tagging @raj for routing playbook if it's capacity.
sam: quick check — tails of the queue look spiky, KV-cache hit drops to 18% concurrently. running: `curl -s http://ops-metrics/emb-queue | jq .rate` -> 1345
maria: customer-impact? any external errors reported?
sam: on top of 429s we're seeing backlog increase and degraded latency for batch-embed calls. CS pinged with a heads up (low severity, some search experimental jobs affected).
oncall-bot: pd note: if ack duration > 15m and no mitigation, auto-escalate to eng-sre.
raj: can we split traffic to fallback model variant? If kv-cache cold, warmup small model to absorb burst. I can spin a small pool in eu-west-1 (dedicated fallback v1.1-faster).
sam: start warmup pls. also increasing worker autoscaler threshold now. running: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/emb-service --replicas=12`
raj: warmup started, allocating 4 fallback instances. hitting them with warmup requests. :hammer_and_wrench:
emma: noted. sam, can you post a short status for CS with ETA? they asked for 15m cadence.
sam: CS ping: "We’re mitigating an embeddings backlog in eu-west-1. Failures (429) observed; warmup & scale initiated. Expected recovery 10–20m; will update in 15m."
maria: thanks. any config rollbacks in flight?
sam: no deploys. change is scaling + routing to fallback model. tracking in incident doc PD-9832.
oncall-bot: timer started for 15m update.
(10m later)
sam: update: queue rate down to 420, kv-cache hit back to 62%. 429 rate trending to 0. Rolling back temporary replicas to baseline. If stable for next 10m we'll close.
emma: Customer update posted. good work. :thumbsup:
raj: deallocating fallback instances now. leaving autoscaler at slightly higher threshold to avoid immediate re-trigger.
maria: any postmortem action items? we should add a runbook step to pre-warm kv-cache on large burst patterns.
sam: agree — adding to incident doc and assigning to eng-runtime for a short task. will create a ticket after this thread.
oncall-bot: PD-9832 marked: mitigated, monitoring. will auto-close if no regressions in 30m.
pagerbot: RESOLVED — page resolved by mitigation (warmup + scale). summary posted to #incidents.
